scope: IS2 prototype page0 inventory, real validated READ_PAGE lifecycle and cold authority. Existing public IS1 contract remains unchanged.

READ_PAGE accepts only static/CRC-valid FB,page0,session0/current,sequence0 while idle; no sequence/session/generation/progress/watchdog commit.

Cold reset clears page flags. Existing global fault/config/serial admission priorities are retained, and zero-gap CS handoff remains a transport rejection.
The copied IS2 driver rejects unsupported features and counts, parses page0, then bounds unqualified retries before CONFIGURE/ARM. The unchanged IS1 driver rejects this proposed profile.
